articles.summary: Shore Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: SHBI) (the "Company" or "Shore Bancshares"), the holding company for Shore United Bank, N.A. (the "Bank"), reported net income for the third quarter of 2026 of $16.8 million, or $0.50 per diluted common share, compared to net income of $18.9 million, or $0.56 per diluted common share, for the second quarter of 2026, and net income of $14.3 million, or $0.43 per diluted common share, for the third quarter of 2025. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Pre-tax Pre-provision Income ("PTPP") , a non-U.S. generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP") (1) financial measure – PTPP for the third quarter of 2026 increased $1.5 million to $27.5 million, from $26.1 million in the second quarter of 2026. PTPP increased primarily due to an increase in interest income of $2.6 million and a decrease in noninterest expense of $405 thousand.
